reviews.title: Free Version isn’t Worth it
reviews.text: You can only see around 7-8 days that you’ve logged, anything before that you’ll never see again. Super weird to not have access to your OWN pictures, you can’t remove or edit anything from previous days.

reviews.title: Great concept, too many ads
reviews.text: Also, now all of a sudden, the app won’t work and doesn’t upload my photos ffs.

reviews.title: NO CANCEL OPTION
reviews.text: There’s no option to cancel a free trial-BUYER BEWARE!!

reviews.title: Bombards You With Ads!!!
reviews.text: This app just bombards you with ads!  Not just to upgrade but for Yoga and stuff.  I even paid for premium.  Every upgrade they do causes something to go wrong like acknowledging you have premium.  So then you have paid all this money for premium and still get bombarded with ads.  I just want to scream at the app. Mia the owner doesn’t have a clue how to fix things.  English isn’t even her first language, so there is a language barrier also.  Save yourself some extreme frustration and run the other way from this app.  I would give it a negative number it I could.

reviews.title: No free option
reviews.text: There is no free version without an eventual cost. They offer a 30 day trial but it costs money after that. So continuing a free version is not possible. They don’t tell you this anywhere on the app store either. Sneaky marketing.

reviews.title: NOT free
reviews.text: Downloaded and you cant get past the subscription screen. You HAVE to subscribe to use the app. Trash. Im not paying 10 bucks a month for this. Rediculous.

reviews.title: Says free. Is not. Only trial.
reviews.text: If you want a free option, don’t bother downloading

reviews.title: Pay or get nothing
reviews.text: Unfortunately this isn’t an app you can use for a while unless you’re willing to pay the subscription. You can’t even see what you ate a week ago unless you pay. Do the developers know that if you make an app free, you’re supposed to let it do what it’s supposed to? Why make an app “free” if you won’t let it do what it’s supposed to unless you pay? Just charge the subscription from the get go. What’s the point on me taking these pictures if I can’t even access them later? I would’ve kept them on my camera roll if I would’ve know I wouldn’t be able to see anything I ate beyond last week. I will find another app or keep the photos on my notes app or something. Needless to mention that half the app is just pop-ups trying to force you to pay for a subscription. Not worth it.

reviews.title: I wouldn’t recommend
reviews.text: It just wasn’t what I needed and it was kinda a busy. It had all premium and it was quite annoying.

reviews.title: Free Trial Scam
reviews.text: There is no free trial. It says a free week with annual subscription. I signed up and cancelled the same day. Got charged $29.99. Developers just said “pursue a refund with Apple”.

reviews.title: Solid but too many options locked behind paywall
reviews.text: I did like the app but I can’t recommend it. The pricing is way too high for what’s essentially a photo organizer. If the lifetime was in the $20-30 range I think it would be worth it but even on a discount the app only gets down to $90 which is insane. I’ll been uninstalling and looking for an alternative.

reviews.title: Free use is next to useless.
reviews.text: Downloaded and deleted in less than 5 minutes. After declining what seems at least 10 different try this subscriptions and each time the close or x or nothing you being harder and harder to find. The app only then tells you the free function is a 1 day diary. There are plenty of other good options. To bad this one never gave me a chance to test it
